LiF.source: NBS / ICDD (a = 4.0270 Å); Ott, Z. Kristallogr. 63, 222 (1926); B(Li), B(F) and the mosaic are assumptions

NaCl.source: LD P6.3.3.1 (a0 = 564.02 pm, d = 282.01 pm); Walker et al., Am. Mineral. 89, 204 (2004)

Si.source: CODATA 2018 (a); Heacock et al., Science 2021 (B = 0.476 Å²)

muscovite.source: Guggenheim, Chang & Koster van Groos, Am. Mineral. 72, 537 (1987), 20 °C, ideal composition

description: Crystal presets (braggsim.crystal.PRESETS). r_n = k f_sq_rel[n−1] exp(−2B(n²−1)s_1²), s_1 = 1/(2 d_pm): k = cell_scale (× exp(2 B_fit/(2 d_NaCl)²) if not fitted_debye_waller; B_fit = params.debye_waller_pm2, in pm², s in pm⁻¹), B = params.debye_waller_pm2 if fitted_debye_waller else 0 (scan.ModelParams.order_strengths). mu_factor is applied only for non-NaCl crystals, per order at λ_n = 2d sinθ/n on the θ grid before the Gaussian convolution, and per line component at its own λ. mu_per_cm = linear attenuation in 1/cm on lambda_pm of mu_rho.json (log–log interpolation, ends held); mu_factor = mu_per_cm[NaCl] / mu_per_cm[X] per λ. Non-NaCl crystals are also multiplied by extinction_ratio = y_X,n(λ)/y_NaCl,1(λ) at the same λ (crystal.extinction_ratio) and k uses exp(2 B_th/(2 d_NaCl)²) with B_th = 130 pm² (1.3 Å², NaCl thermal) instead of B_fit. extinction[n−1] = y of order n on the first len(row) nodes of lambda_pm of mu_rho.json (λ ≤ 2d sin85°/n plus one node; NaCl has order 1 only, the reference y); interpolate log y vs log λ, end values held
